scientific_question: Although transition coordinates are not common across held-out species, do species-specific flower-colour discontinuity edges recur where independently pre-colour-frozen macroclimate changes more strongly, beyond geographic distance?

external_source.provider: WorldClim 2.1 10 arc-minute bioclimatic variables aggregated to the independently frozen equal-area 250-km atlas grid before colour opening
external_source.note: This source is not substituted for the prospectively named CHELSA 2.1 member of the original G3 predictor family. It is a separately labelled legacy-source secondary validation because these exact WorldClim bytes were frozen before global colour outcomes.

external_predictor.name: worldclim_multivariate_climate_distance
external_predictor.photo_cell_assignment: exact equal_area_cell_ids on the frozen 128x64 longitude-by-sin(latitude) grid
external_predictor.complete_source_cells: source rows with finite BIO1, BIO4, BIO12 and BIO15
external_predictor.standardization: z-score each BIO variable across all complete frozen 250-km source cells using population standard deviation ddof=0 before joining colour
external_predictor.edge_definition: sqrt(mean((zBIO_j_left-zBIO_j_right)^2)) across BIO1, BIO4, BIO12 and BIO15
external_predictor.missing_external_rule: if either edge endpoint lacks a complete frozen climate source cell, external score is missing and that edge occurrence is excluded; never recode missing climate to zero

colour_geometry_and_schedule.edge_colour_score: soft four-group Jensen-Shannon divergence ranked within species within each outer realization exactly as G1

test.statistic: equal-species mean within-species partial Spearman correlation of ranked colour edge score with frozen multivariate climate distance, controlling ranked great-circle edge distance
test.null: the exact same 999 within-species colour-vector permutations as G1 applied to the exact same 200 outer schedules and fixed external climate vector
test.secondary_support_rule: observed mean species partial rho > 0 and p_upper < 0.05
test.multiplicity: none within this one-predictor legacy-source secondary validation; this p-value is not promoted into the original CHELSA G3 family

claim_if_supported: Within the public-photo RGFCA frame, species-specific flower-colour discontinuity edges show positive alignment with independently pre-colour-frozen WorldClim macroclimate contrast beyond ranked geographic distance. This is secondary legacy-source evidence for recurrent environmental process, not evidence for common transition coordinates, not the original CHELSA confirmatory G3 test, and not causal evidence.
claim_if_not_supported: The independently frozen WorldClim secondary test does not support a common macroclimate-contrast alignment of species-specific flower-colour edges beyond geographic distance.
